concept: Two Overlapping Busts with Oval Heads
description: Two human busts stand side by side with separate upright oval heads and broad curved shoulders. The left torso overlaps the right one, and both figures end along the same flat baseline.

concept: Person in Rounded Square
description: A plain round-headed person with short sleeve lines stands within a rounded square.

concept: Upright Sprinkler with Arcing Water Jets
description: A sprinkler rises on a narrow upright stem above a low rounded base. A shallow nozzle bowl sits at the top, with four curved water jets spreading outward around a central upright stream.

concept: Left-Facing Woman with Swept Long Hair
description: A woman's head faces left with a plain profile, small nose and closed lips. A swept inner hairline curves from the forehead toward the back, while long hair tapers behind the neck.

concept: Ascending Staircase Side Outline
description: A staircase climbs from lower left to upper right through four flat steps and upright risers. A long horizontal base extends beneath it, while the highest landing continues rightward above the open side.

concept: Long Drinking Straw with Angled Bend
description: A long slender drinking straw rises at a slight diagonal before bending toward the upper right. Its short upper section angles more sharply than the lower stem, with a softened elbow between them.

concept: Five Staggered Masonry Blocks
description: Five rectangular masonry blocks form three courses, with two blocks above and below a single centered block. The offset middle course leaves open recesses at both sides of the small wall fragment.

concept: Rounded Masonry Panel with Staggered Joints
description: A rectangular masonry panel has rounded outer corners and three horizontal courses. Offset vertical joints divide the upper and lower courses into two blocks and the middle course into three.

concept: Round Sun with Eight Separate Rays
description: A plain circular sun sits at the center of eight detached straight rays. Four rays point vertically and horizontally, while four shorter diagonal rays fill the spaces between them.

concept: Check in Rounded Square
description: A check with a long rising right arm sits within a rounded square.

concept: Church Steeple with Sloping Side Wings
description: A tall church tower supports a sharply pointed spire above a plain rectangular body. A narrow arched opening marks the tower front, and low sloping side wings spread outward from its base.

concept: Round Waffle with Square Grid
description: A round waffle has straight horizontal and vertical grooves crossing its face in a square grid. The outer circular edge clips the corner cells, leaving a broad centered pattern without any separate topping.

concept: Closed Carton with Front Tape Tab
description: A closed carton has a broad rectangular front with rounded lower corners and a shallow trapezoidal top. A short central tape tab folds over the top edge onto the otherwise plain front face.

concept: Lidded Cooking Pot above Gas Flame
description: A deep cooking pot has a flat lid, a rounded knob and short side handles. A separate three-point flame burns directly beneath its rounded base, forming a simple pot-over-burner cooking scene.

concept: Lidded Pot above Heating Marks
description: A deep lidded pot with a rounded knob and two short side handles sits above a row of upright heating marks. A short horizontal cooking-surface line runs beneath the marks.

concept: Crescent Moon beside Five-Point Star
description: A broad crescent moon curves around an open space on its right, ending in two sharp tips. A separate five-pointed star sits between the tips, above the center of the crescent.

concept: Rounded Horizontal Strip with Diagonal Bands
description: A long horizontal strip has rounded ends and three diagonal interior seams sloping upward to the right. The seams divide its plain face into alternating broad slanted sections within one continuous border.

concept: Diagonal Pencil above Short Written Line
description: A pencil lies diagonally from a sharp lower-left tip to a rounded upper-right end. Seams separate the pointed nib and short end cap, while a short horizontal written line sits below.

concept: Speech Bubble with Diagonal Slash
description: A rounded speech bubble with a lower-right tail contains a rising diagonal slash.

concept: Front-Facing Woman with Flared Shoulder-Length Hair
description: A woman faces forward with a blank face framed by shoulder-length hair that flares outward at the ends. A central part rises above the forehead, and a rounded neckline joins the shoulders below.

concept: Scissors beside Partial Crossed-Circle Mark
description: Closed scissors stand upright beside an incomplete circular arc joined to a diagonal cross at upper right.

concept: Front-Facing Woman with Rounded Bob
description: A blank-faced woman has a broad rounded bob that ends just above her shoulders. The hair parts at the center of her forehead, and a long neck descends into a rounded neckline.

concept: Short-Haired Woman with Visible Sleeve Seams
description: A front-facing woman has a blank face beneath short hair with a slightly off-center part. Her rounded neckline meets a broad torso with two short vertical sleeve seams and a flat lower edge.

concept: Woman with Long Straight Hair and Empty Circle
description: A front-facing woman with long straight hair has a blank circle overlapping the lower-right side of her torso.

concept: Woman with Short Bobbed Hair and Empty Circle
description: A front-facing woman with short bobbed hair has a blank circle overlapping the lower-right side of her torso.

concept: Curved Stocking with Broad Folded Cuff
description: A stocking hangs upright with a broad rounded cuff and a foot curving toward the lower left. A curved heel patch sits along the right edge where the leg narrows into the foot.

concept: Complete Five-Point Star Outline
description: A complete five-pointed star has one upright point, two wide side points and two lower tips. Its inward corners are slightly softened, and the enclosed face is entirely blank.

concept: Bee with Spread Wings and Striped Abdomen
description: A bee faces upward with two antennae, a round head and a broad central thorax. Two wings spread sideways above thin bent legs, while horizontal bands cross its pointed lower abdomen.

concept: Thick Steak with Oval Bone Center
description: A thick steak has an uneven rounded upper face with a narrow end projecting toward the lower left. An oval bone sits near the wider end, and a curved lower edge shows the cut's thickness.

concept: Front-Facing Train on Short Rails
description: A front-facing train has a tall rounded body, broad windshield and two circular lower headlights. A narrow roof band crosses its top, while two slanting rails and a cross-tie extend beneath it.

concept: Long-Handled Pan above Open Flame
description: A shallow pan extends to the right of a long straight handle, with rounded lower corners beneath its flat rim. A three-point flame sits directly below the bowl as a cooking heat source.

concept: Diagonal Carrot with Three Leaf Stems
description: A carrot tapers toward the lower left from a broad rounded shoulder at upper right. Two short diagonal creases cross its body, and three curved leaf stems rise from the top.

concept: Horizontal Strap with Broad Rounded End
description: A long horizontal strap has a rounded left end and a larger upright rounded terminal at the right. The terminal overlaps the narrow band, and both sections have entirely plain interiors.

concept: Small Gabled House with Square Window
description: A small house has a broad triangular roof projecting beyond its straight side walls. A single square window sits in the center of the plain front, above a level lower edge.
